post.title: How an affiliate link pays a creator up to 10% of your order
post.ig:
That link pays creators up to 10% of your order.
Amazon counts a click for 24 hours (items added to cart in that window: up to 89 days).
Amazon standard rates as of Oct 2026: 10% luxury beauty, 4% all other categories, 0% gift cards.
Example: $200 order x 4% = $8 to the creator. Your price is usually the same.
The FTC's Endorsement Guides (updated 2023) say creators should clearly disclose paid links.
Sources: Amazon Associates Central, FTC Endorsement Guides (16 CFR Part 255).
